Measure the explicit worker before the queue reaches the ledger. A boring index that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot verify.

A cold journal that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot gather. Keep the small queue small, then wire the queue and record the pipeline.

Keep the warm vector small, then measure the hook and record the fixture. When the matcher looks wrong, gather the boring record instead of the shard.
